thread:
incident-bot: P0 pager: spike in latency + 5xxs for economy tier in eu-west. error rate +120% last 3m. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/eu-west/latency (auto-incident created: INC-2026-045)
oncall-marcus: on it — paging rotation: Marcus (me) -> Priya next. grabbing logs + traces.
priya-sre: joining. I see a sharp increase in queueing on nodepool-eu-w-eco-02.
ben-platform: looks like autoscaler didn't spin up due to quota cap hit. quota usage spike for economy GPUs at ~98%.
emily-product: any customer impact? reported alerts from two customers in EU on support queue.
customer-ops-jake: confirming — CustA and CustB reporting slow responses and some 502s since ~11:04UTC.
oncall-marcus: quick mitigation plan: 1) temporarily apply global rate-limit for economy tier by tenant to 10rps 2) steer a portion of economy traffic to eu-central 3) suspend economy-priority offload (the promotion path) to reduce amplification.
priya-sre: agreed. I'll apply the rate-limit and start smart-route shift. pinging ops-bot to run the playbook.
ops-bot: Running playbook: "live-mitigate/economy-eu-west". Step 1/4: apply rate limit. Command: ```rbctl routing policy update --tier economy --region eu-west --rate-limit "10r/s/tenant"``` -> OK
priya-sre: rate-limit applied. Observability: error rate down slightly but latency still elevated.
ben-platform: initiating steering: ```rbctl smart-route adjust --from-region eu-west --to-region eu-central --tier economy --pct 45 --grace 30s``` -> queued. Note: eu-central capacity free ~30%.
oncall-marcus: flipping the promotion toggle off: ```rbctl feature-toggle set economy-promotion false --env production --reason "mitigation INC-2026-045"``` -> done.
emily-product: good call. I'm drafting a short customer notice for impacted tenants: will post to status and notify the two reporting customers.
sre-manager-tina: keep me posted. if steering doesn't reduce load in 10m escalate to Dedicated fallback (pin customers to dedicated pools) — we may have to OR-backfill.
priya-sre: steering at 45% is in effect. Observability: cpu on eu-west nodes dropping, queue depth decreasing. lat p50 -> 420ms (was 1.2s), p95 still ~1.6s.
oncall-marcus: still seeing some 502s for a minority of keys — suspect KV cache miss storms on some model shards. ben can you trigger a soft rolling restart on nodepool-eu-w-eco-02 to clear hot state?
ben-platform: scheduling rolling restart, one shard at a time, drain then restart. Command: ```infractl drain nodepool-eu-w-eco-02 --grace 60 && infractl restart node --id node-18``` -> ACK. Restart started.
ops-bot: automated quota lift recommended: bump economy GPU quota by 10% for region eu-west to allow autoscaler to spin. Require manual confirmation to proceed.
priya-sre: approve quota bump now. ben-platform: please apply.
ben-platform: quota bump applied. Autoscaler triggered and added 3 nodes. Observability: more capacity, error rate trending down.
customer-ops-jake: CustA reports improved timings. CustB still sees intermittent 502s on long chat sessions.
oncall-marcus: for CustB sessions we might enforce session-length rlimit for economy to avoid long-running KV pressure. Proposal: per-tenant token cap 20k tokens/session for economy.
emily-product: agree — we can temporarily enforce this for economy-only and notify customers. I'll coordinate messaging and rollback timeline (2h target).
sre-manager-tina: good mitigation. Next steps: 1) monitor for 30m 2) if stable, remove hard rate-limit and keep steering at reduced pct 3) postmortem owner: Priya 4) timeline & customer comms: Emily/Jake.
priya-sre: taking postmortem. capturing notes now. initial root cause hypothesis: autoscaler quota boundary + cache storm + shard hotness leading to queueing.
oncall-marcus: last check: p95 latency 580ms, error rate down to +15% vs baseline. marking incident as "degraded" not fully recovered.
incident-bot: INC-2026-045 status update: mitigation in progress, severity downgraded to P1 (degraded). next update in 20m or on major change.
ben-platform: rolling restart finished. nodepool-eu-w-eco-02 back to healthy.
customer-ops-jake: CustB acknowledges partial improvement, asks for ETA to full recovery.
emily-product: we estimate full stabilization in ~45m if current trends hold. notifying CustB now.
sre-manager-tina: if anything spikes, re-pager me immediately. otherwise let's keep this thread for logs and next updates.
oncall-marcus: copying runbook actions into the incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-045/actions
priya-sre: noted. saving relevant traces and exports.
emily-product: posted status update and emailed CustA/CustB with mitigation details and ETA. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: auto-snapshot created: /snapshots/INC-2026-045/3061234567
oncall-marcus: thanks team. continuing to monitor, will update if anything changes.
